_doc: Character bible for A Christmas Carol (Dickens, Gutenberg 46). Single source of truth for visual consistency. Teen art tier (V7). Same ICONIC TRAIT SILHOUETTE strategy as the Frankenstein bible: silhouette + head signature + trait-mark so each character is instantly distinct and consistent across all 5 staves.
_strategy: ICONIC TRAIT SILHOUETTE — every character = a distinct silhouette + a head signature + a trait-mark object, so free-tier FLUX keeps them apart and consistent.

scrooge.name: Scrooge
scrooge.role: protagonist — cold, miserly old man who is redeemed
scrooge.silhouette: a bent, stiff, thin old man
scrooge.head: a sharp pointed nose, shrivelled cheeks, a hard tight frown, thin lips
scrooge.trait_mark: a long shabby dark tailcoat and a walking cane; later a white nightcap and gown
scrooge.expression: sour and pinched, softening to wonder by the end
scrooge.canonical: a bent thin miserly old man with a sharp pointed nose, shrivelled frowning face and thin lips, in a long shabby dark tailcoat, carrying a cane
scrooge.anchor: a bent thin old man, pointed nose, hard frown, shabby dark tailcoat + cane
scrooge.consistency: the ONLY bent pointed-nose miser; sour frown; dark shabby tailcoat (or nightcap+gown at home); never jolly until the finale.

marley.name: Marley's Ghost
marley.role: Scrooge's dead partner — a warning spirit
marley.silhouette: a translucent ghostly man dragging a long heavy chain
marley.head: a gaunt pale face with a cloth bandage tied up round the head and jaw, a pigtail
marley.trait_mark: a long chain wound about him forged of cash-boxes, keys, padlocks, ledgers and heavy purses
marley.canonical: a translucent ghostly man in an old-fashioned pigtail, waistcoat and tights, a cloth bandage tied round his head and jaw, wound in a long heavy chain made of cash-boxes, keys, padlocks and ledgers
marley.anchor: translucent ghost, head-bandage + pigtail, bound in a chain of cash-boxes and padlocks
marley.consistency: the ONLY see-through figure; ALWAYS bound in the cash-box chain with the jaw bandage; never solid.

bob.name: Bob Cratchit
bob.silhouette: a thin stooped clerk with no overcoat
bob.head: a mild kindly face, thinning hair
bob.trait_mark: a long white woollen comforter (scarf) trailing down, fingerless mittens
bob.canonical: a thin poor clerk with a mild kindly face, wrapped in a long white woollen comforter scarf and fingerless mittens, no overcoat
bob.anchor: thin clerk, long white comforter scarf, fingerless mittens, no coat
bob.consistency: the ONLY one in the long white comforter scarf; always coatless and cold; gentle.

fred.name: Fred
fred.head: a handsome ruddy glowing face, bright eyes, side-whiskers
fred.trait_mark: a cheerful scarf and a sprig of holly on his coat, always mid-laugh
fred.canonical: a handsome ruddy cheerful young man with side-whiskers and bright eyes, glowing with warmth, a scarf and a sprig of holly on his coat
fred.anchor: ruddy glowing young man, side-whiskers, holly sprig, warm laugh
fred.consistency: the ONLY glowing cheerful young man; ruddy warm face; holly sprig; opposite of Scrooge.

past.name: Ghost of Christmas Past
past.role: first of the three spirits — memory
past.silhouette: a small luminous figure, child-like yet aged
past.head: a strange young-old face, long white hair, a bright jet of clear light springing from the crown
past.trait_mark: a pure white tunic with a holly sprig, holding a cap shaped like a candle-extinguisher
past.canonical: a small luminous spirit that seems both a child and an old person, with long white hair and a bright flame of light springing from its head, in a pure white tunic trimmed with summer flowers, holding a cap shaped like a candle-extinguisher
past.anchor: small glowing child-old spirit, white tunic, a flame from its crown, extinguisher-cap
past.consistency: the ONLY small glowing white-tunic spirit with a flame from its head; carries the extinguisher-cap.

present.name: Ghost of Christmas Present
present.role: second of the three spirits — abundance & joy
present.head: a genial bearded face, dark brown curls, a holly wreath crown with icicles
present.trait_mark: a deep-green fur-lined robe open at the chest and a glowing torch shaped like a horn of plenty
present.canonical: a jolly cheerful bearded giant with dark brown curls, crowned with a holly wreath, wearing a deep-green fur-lined robe open at the chest, bearing a glowing torch shaped like a horn of plenty
present.anchor: jolly bearded giant, holly-wreath crown, green fur robe, glowing horn-torch
present.consistency: the ONLY jolly bearded giant in the green holly-crowned robe with the horn-torch; huge and warm.

future.name: Ghost of Christmas Yet to Come
future.role: third of the three spirits — the silent Phantom of the future
future.head: no visible face — only darkness within a deep black hood
future.trait_mark: a full-length black hooded robe; one pale outstretched pointing hand is the only part visible
future.canonical: a tall silent Phantom shrouded head to foot in a deep black hooded robe that hides its face entirely, only one pale outstretched pointing hand visible
future.anchor: tall faceless black-hooded phantom, only a pointing hand visible
future.consistency: the ONLY all-black faceless hooded phantom; never speaks; only the pointing hand shows.

tim.name: Tiny Tim
tim.role: Bob Cratchit's frail, good little son
tim.silhouette: a very small frail boy leaning on a crutch
tim.head: a sweet pale little face, big trusting eyes
tim.trait_mark: a little wooden crutch and an iron brace on his small legs
tim.canonical: a very small frail sweet-faced boy with big trusting eyes, an iron brace on his little legs, leaning on a small wooden crutch
tim.anchor: tiny frail boy, small crutch, iron leg-brace, sweet pale face
tim.consistency: the ONLY small boy with the little crutch + leg-brace; frail and sweet.

fezziwig.name: Fezziwig
fezziwig.role: Scrooge's jovial old master (in Christmas Past)
fezziwig.head: a round jolly face under a large Welsh wig
fezziwig.trait_mark: a big Welsh wig, a comfortable waistcoat and shiny buckled shoes, calves that shine
fezziwig.canonical: a jovial rotund old gentleman with a round beaming face under a big Welsh wig, a comfortable waistcoat and shiny buckled shoes
fezziwig.anchor: rotund beaming old master, big Welsh wig, buckled shiny shoes
fezziwig.consistency: the ONLY rotund Welsh-wig master with buckled shoes; always jovial and dancing.
